validation.red_regression: The reported wide-overlap word/timestamp fixture produced Один before the fix and один after it.

limitations: Private author recording unavailable: supplied URL returned HTTP 404. The reported mechanism is reproduced with a model-free word/timestamp fixture, not independently on that recording.
Seven public recordings at three offsets; offsets are repeated views, not independent recordings.

Baseline is the saved, previously validated PR455 binary. Candidate also includes the subsequently accepted dependency updates; timings are an end-to-end regression check, not isolated attribution to overlap handling.
Seven alternating timing pairs per head/duration on one Linux CPU host; small timing changes are not a speedup claim. RSS/HWM are process measurements, not unique physical footprint.
